services.desc: Advance tickets are recommended for all museum visitors to skip the line. Walk-ups are always welcome. Adults: $25 Seniors (65+) / Veterans: $22 Students with ID: $15 Kids (6-16): $10 Children 5 and under: FREE Admission to Kidspace: FREE MASS MoCA MEMBERS Museum admission is always free for MASS MoCA members; members can reserve their free admission tickets before arriving by logging in. JAMES TURRELL: INTO THE LIGHT Into the Light is a multi-decade retrospective of several James Turrell works.
